subject: EmpireCare - security & compliance economics: packaging proposal
messages:
From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@empirecare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EmpireCare compliance packaging inquiry

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for taking this. Attached is a short requirements doc (empirecare-requirements.pdf) summarizing what our security and procurement teams need for a production pilot: HIPAA support, audit log retention for 12 months, an HSM-backed KMS for key material, and the option to restrict data residency to our US region (we may add EU later).

Can you send a compact pricing structure for: 1) audit logging (per GB/month tiers), 2) HSM/KMS (seat vs throughput options), and 3) a residency surcharge (if applicable) — plus any one-time implementation or evidence delivery fees? Also include what evidence you can deliver up front (SOC 2 artifact, pen test summary).

We are targeting a pilot start mid-September and need a clear commercial path to a 12-month paid commitment if the pilot goes well.

Thanks —
Jenna Ortiz
Director, Procurement
EmpireCare
[Attachment: empirecare-requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@empirecare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Aug 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EmpireCare compliance packaging inquiry

Jenna —

Appreciate the clear brief and timeline. Quick high-level response so procurement has something to review before we follow up with a formal spreadsheet: 

- Audit logging: $0.020 per GB/month (0-5TB), volume break to $0.015 per GB beyond 5TB; 12-month retention standard for the pilot can be included in the pilot credit.
- KMS/HSM options:
  • HSM seat (dedicated appliance-backed key escrow): $3,500/month per seat (recommended for regulatory audits).
  • Managed KMS (software keys w/ customer CMK): $900/month + $0.005 per 1k requests for high-throughput use.
- Data residency surcharge (US-only enforcement): $0.012 per 1k API calls routed to US-only pools.
- One-time implementation/evidence delivery fee: typically $12,500 (covers attestation packaging, onboarding runs, and coordination).

Concession options we can offer for a committed 12-month purchase (details to confirm in the formal quote):
- 15% bundle discount on compliance addons if EmpireCare commits to 12 months of baseline spend (defined in a draft SOW).
- Waive the one-time evidence/implementation fee for a paid pilot > $50k committed spend.

I'll have Aditya add a brief technical appendix on HSM sizing for your expected QPS and a formal line-item quote (spreadsheet) by EOD tomorrow. Laura — can you confirm whether standard MSA exceptions (audit evidence SLA, indemnity carveouts) need to be flagged now so we can include alternative contract language?

Next steps: I'll send the line-item workbook + SOC2 artifacts tomorrow. If it looks good, we can prepare a DocuSign for pilot approval and a mutually agreed SOW.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@empirecare.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HSM sizing + technical notes for EmpireCare (internal + for Jenna)

Forwarding a short technical note to help with the HSM seat vs managed KMS decision. Key points:

- If EmpireCare expects sustained 50k cryptographic operations/minute, recommend a dual HSM seat deployment (active-active) to meet latency targets. One seat handles ~30k ops/min with headroom.
- For lower throughput (<=10k ops/min), managed KMS + CMK with rate-limiting and on-host caches will be materially cheaper.
- On evidence: we can deliver SOC 2 Type II report redacted (control mappings), pen-test executive summary, and KMS architecture diagram within 3 business days of an NDA. Full log exports for audit are available via secure SFTP.

Attachment: SOC2-evidence.zip (contains sample artifacts and our control mapping matrix).

Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-evidence.zip (zip)]

From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@empirecare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blackburn <tom.blackburn@empirecare.com>, procurement@empirecare.com
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EmpireCare compliance packaging inquiry

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick run-down and Aditya for the technical note. A few clarifying asks from procurement/legal before we can route to budgeting: 

1) The $3,500/month HSM seat number is higher than we expected. If we commit to a 12-month contract and 2x expected seat utilization immediately (to cover our initial growth), what concession could Redwood provide?
2) We would prefer a fixed-composite price for the first 12 months (audit logs + HSM or managed KMS + residency) so we can budget. Can you provide a blended fixed option?
3) Implementation fee: if Redwood waives the $12.5k for the pilot, will you still guarantee evidence delivery timeline and a named SLA point-of-contact? Procurement needs that in writing.

If you can get me a fixed blended price and a concession path (and an updated line-item quote), we can escalate to finance and aim to sign the pilot by Aug 10.

Best,
Jenna Ortiz
Director, Procurement
EmpireCare

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@empirecare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Aug 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EmpireCare compliance packaging inquiry — concession pathway and fixed pilot price

Jenna —

Thanks — below is a compact concession pathway and a fixed 12-month blended option tailored to the pilot ask. I've attached a formal workbook (redwood-compliance-quote-empirecare.xlsx) with line items and math.

Fixed blended pilot (12 months) — Option A (HSM seat):
- Includes: 1 HSM seat (active), audit logs up to 2TB/month, US-only data residency enforcement, SOC 2 artifacts delivery.
- Fixed price: $42,500/month (equivalent unit economics -> HSM seat + audit logs + residency + 24/7 SRE on-call).

Fixed blended pilot (12 months) — Option B (managed KMS):
- Includes: managed KMS (CMK), audit logs up to 2TB/month, US-only residency enforcement.
- Fixed price: $18,900/month.

Concession pathway if EmpireCare signs a 12-month commitment by Aug 15: 
- HSM Option: 20% discount off list HSM seat pricing for months 1-6 (applied to the fixed pilot price above), plus one-time implementation fee waived.
- Managed KMS Option: 10% discount off the fixed pilot price for months 1-6, implementation fee waived.
- We will commit to delivering SOC2 Type II redacted artifacts and the KMS architecture diagram within 48 hours of an NDA and will assign a named security liaison (Laura Bennett) for evidence coordination and SLA escalations.

Contract mechanics / next steps:
1) I will upload the line-item workbook to the HS record (HS-91234) and mount the DocuSign envelope for the pilot SOW (link below).
2) If you sign the pilot SOW, we will schedule onboarding and evidence delivery within 3 business days.
3) Laura — can you confirm the liaison role and whether that is acceptable in lieu of contract language in the first SOW?

DocuSign (pilot SOW): https://docusign.com/embedded?doc=abc123
